phases.name: National Universities Top 50 completion
phases.expected_record_count: at least 50; larger when cutoff or earlier ranks have ties
phases.source_strategy: U.S. News public ranking page or official release first; university official rank page only when it directly states 2026 edition, National Universities category and numeric rank.
phases.fallback_policy: If direct evidence is unavailable, retain a partial/unresolved observation and coverage gap; never infer a rank or fill a name from memory.
phases.identity_policy: Preserve source display name and create an explicit mapping; defer UNITID unless separately source-verified.
phases.validation_plan: Require full artifact validation, rank <=50, edition direct evidence, preserved ties, and coverage matrix proof for every numeric rank/tie group.

phases.name: High-yield undergraduate program stream completion
phases.priority_rationale: These broad subject, degree-structure, or high-demand business streams are the most plausible sources of schools outside National Universities Top 50. Expected contribution is qualitative only until verified cutoff records exist.

phases.name: Remaining undergraduate program stream completion
phases.batch_plan: Process six streams per batch, preserving a separate full artifact bundle and coverage matrix for each batch.
phases.stop_conditions: Stop a stream only after every numeric rank <=20 and all ties are verified, or after lawful source routes are exhausted and the coverage gap/rejected observations are recorded.
phases.partial_unresolved_policy: Partial and unresolved observations remain auditable but never enter completed candidate staging.

priority: U.S. News official public page or release
University or college official page with direct edition/category/rank
Trusted public institution only as supplementary cross-check
source_policy.edition_rule: Without direct edition evidence, record as partially verified or unresolved; it cannot enter the completed universe candidate.

acceptance_criteria: National Universities numeric ranks <=50 and all ties processed
All 28 included undergraduate program streams numeric ranks <=20 and all ties processed
Only verified records enter completed candidate; partial/unresolved are excluded
No-verified streams are documented without fake schools
Duplicate identities are resolved and Global/Graduate contamination is zero
Completed corpus validation passes and a completed ranking universe candidate is generated
Independent Gate audit passes before any final database-universe claim
